name: acp-codex2opencode
description: Codex plugin for OpenCode ACP delegation closed-loop

interface.shortDescription: OpenCode ACP delegated closed-loop execution for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Provides session initialization, multi-turn delegation, rework loops, model switching, cancellation, and close operations via MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: 先在主对话判定起始阶段（design/planning/implementation/need_user_input），再调用 ACP Delegate Bridge 的 `delegate.task.execute`（action=start）。
调用 start 时必须带上 `start_phase`，并先完成模型闸门（NEEDS_MODEL_CONFIRM/NEEDS_MODEL_SELECTION -> model_confirm/model_select）。
只按 `workflow_status` 与 `next_action_required` 推进到可交付，不要越级跳步骤。
